discovery_scope: Public NVIDIA Technical Blog WordPress posts. The bulk API retains post IDs, canonical URLs and rendered content separately. Canonical duplicate URLs and empty content records are not counted as independent extracted bodies.
terminal_status: All 54 content API pages retrieved. The 5319 unique post IDs equal the reported total, and the final page has 19 records. Imported extraction and residual historical URL attempts finished.
gaps: 31 API records had empty rendered content.
5319 post records collapse to 5298 unique canonical URLs before collector normalization.
API content extraction does not establish reading every article, linked page, diagram or executable example.
Initial generic discovery was interrupted after redundant historical page-size probes; retained source receipts remain visible.
The API also contains external event, training and video reference records. Their snippets are retained, while external target bodies are outside the scoped technical blog article crawl.

Canonical replay of 90 initially short or empty responses recovered 87 substantive articles, classified one navigation route, and found two former CUDAcast URLs redirecting to embedded-computing rather than an article.

read_articles.reading_scope: Complete authored main prose, tips, table and caption text through Get started. Labeled AI generated summary, bios, linked sessions, diagram pixels and runtime were excluded.

recommendations.finding: Score task success against intent and constraints, with separate normal, degraded-tool and ambiguous-input cases. Inspect observable tool calls and side effects, expected schemas, tool budgets and failure categories. Report tokens, tool calls and latency per successful task alongside correctness, because final answers can conceal expensive or unsafe trajectories.
recommendations.boundary: Read authored prose separately from the labeled AI generated summary. Do not require hidden reasoning traces or claim model benchmark scores guarantee task reliability.
evaluations: Identical answers conceal a repeated external side effect.
A degraded tool triggers unbounded retries.
A fast answer omits required intent or constraints.
A deterministic local unit test does not need a model evaluation harness.

candidate_status: Research recommendations only, behavior was not changed and behavioral evaluations were not executed by this publisher task.

api_external_reference_limit.meaning: All API records and rendered snippets were retrieved. These canonical links point to external events, training, videos or promotional resources, whose target bodies are outside the technical blog scope. Historical references remain in the baseline frontier.

attempted_urls_meaning: Legacy alias for processed frontier dispositions, not unique HTTP article requests. See processed_urls, http_article_attempted_urls and body_retrieved_urls.

scope_classification.meaning: External event, training, video, source repository, documentation and promotional references are preserved as excluded_nonarticle dispositions. They do not contribute to scoped technical blog body retrieval or extraction.
